Section 5 – Pronunciation
الأول المتوسط
5

Pronunciation 😊

النطق
Track 23 – can / can't Pronunciation اضغط لسماع نطق can و can't

🎯 Listen to the pronunciation of can and can't. Then practice.

can
can't
Can you ride a bike?
I can ride a bike, but I can't rollerblade.

💡 Key Difference / الفرق الرئيسي

can
Weak & short — unstressed
ضعيفة وقصيرة — غير مشددة
can't
Strong — stressed with /t/
قوية ومشددة مع صوت /t/

🧠 Quick Check — Choose the correct word:

1.I _____ play tennis. (I'm good at it!)
can
can't
2.She _____ swim. She doesn't know how.
can
can't

Conversation ❓

المحادثة
Track 24 – Ali & Imad اضغط للاستماع إلى محادثة علي وعماد
A
Ali
Can you play tennis?
I
Imad
Yes, I can.
A
Ali
Do you want to play a match?
I
Imad
Sure. When's good for you?
A
Ali
I prefer the weekend. I have more free time. How about Thursday afternoon?
I
Imad
I can't. I'm busy. How about Saturday morning?
A
Ali
Good idea. What time?
I
Imad
Eight o'clock.
A
Ali
Eight o'clock, on a Saturday morning! Are you crazy?

💬 Real Talk

When's good for you? = What time is good for you? — متى يناسبك؟
Are you crazy? = You're saying something strange — هل أنت مجنون؟

About the Conversation
الأول المتوسط
🔍

About the Conversation

أسئلة حول المحادثة

اختر الإجابة الصحيحة لكل سؤال

1.Can Imad play tennis?
✅ Yes, he can.
❌ No, he can't.
🤔 He doesn't know.
2.Can Imad play on Thursday afternoon?
✅ Yes, he can.
❌ No, he's busy.
🤔 Maybe on Friday.
3.When can he play? What time?
Friday evening.
Saturday morning at eight o'clock.
Sunday afternoon at ten o'clock.
4.What does Ali think about the time?
He thinks it's great.
He thinks it's too early / strange.
He thinks it's too late.
